description: List a company's EDGAR filings newest-first, filtered by form type and filing-date range. Each row has form, accession, filed date, report period, primary document URL and filing index URL. Amendments (e.g. 10-K/A) are included when filtering by the base form unless include_amendments=false. Older history pages are fetched automatically when needed. Common forms: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF 14A, S-1, 4, 13D/G (SC 13D), 20-F, 6-K.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

forms.description: Form types to include, e.g. ['10-K','10-Q']. Omit for all.

name: list_filings

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; absent on the last page

title: List SEC filings
